Job Description

This is a full-time salaried position with Project Farma, a PerkinElmer company. The successful candidate will reside in one of Project Farma's primary markets and be willing to travel domestically to meet client project requests.

Project Farma’s purpose is to improve patient lives by accelerating the delivery of life-changing therapies. We accomplish this through the successful execution of high-quality life sciences projects across the full project lifecycle. Project Farma (PF) team members collaborate with cross-functional teams to build trusted client relationships, deliver an exceptional customer experience, and contribute to business growth by identifying opportunities and applying data-driven insights to support project planning, cost, schedule, and performance management.

All team members are expected to embody Project Farma’s values by being curious, personable, and unselfish, while maintaining a strong commitment to a Patient Focused and People First mindset.

The Automation Engineer III and Lead Engineer is an advanced individual contributor with demonstrated depth in their technical discipline and a growing record of leading complex workstreams. This role applies strong subject‑matter expertise to solve high‑impact technical and operational challenges, supports technical decision‑making, and contributes to the evolution of standards, methods, or best practices within their area. They partner closely with project and people leaders—while remaining focused on technical delivery rather than formal people management.

Key Responsibilities

The Automation MES & Digital Systems Engineer provides subject matter expertise in the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of digital systems across biologics, pharmaceutical, and novel therapy manufacturing facilities. This role requires deep experience with various MES platforms, Data Repositories, Serialization and integration to manufacturing applications (ERP, LIMS, CMMS, etc) and the ability to author, interpret, and lead documentation such as URS, FRS, Functional Narratives, and detailed system architecture designs.

MES Design & Architecture

  • Develop system architectures and data flows for biologics, pharmaceutical, and advanced therapy manufacturing (DCS, PLC/SCADA, MES, historians, network layers).

  • Develop product recipe strategies across the full application layer of ERP, MES and DCS Batch.

  • Detailed knowledge of Master data and how to define and control Master Data.

  • Create ISA‑88/ISA‑95‑aligned architecture diagrams, inc Application and Data Flow diagrams.

  • Ensure architecture supports scalability, cybersecurity, data integrity, and multi‑product flexibility.

URS / FRS / Design Documentation

Lead the creation, review, and approval of:

  • URS (User Requirements Specifications)

  • FRS (Functional Requirements Specifications)

  • DS / DDS (Design Specifications)

  • Functional & Control Narratives

  • Recipe Design Documentation (ISA‑88 compliant)

  • Automation Standards & Engineering Guidelines

Work cross functionally to translate process requirements into robust digital system design documents.

Digital System Implementation

  • Configure, program, and deploy Digital System within the manufacturing environment.

  • Develop, modify, and test MES (eBR, RbE, eLogbooks, Equipment Tracking, Weigh & Dispense), LIMS, Serialization and CMMS application functionality.

  • Support integration of OEM skids: bioreactors, chromatography systems, filtration skids, CIP/SIP, and fill finish equipment.

Commissioning, Validation & GMP Compliance

  • Detailed knowledge of FAT, SAT, IQ/OQ, and PQ protocols in alignment with GAMP 5 and 21 CFR Part 11.

  • Ensure all changes meet data integrity requirements, change control processes, and validation lifecycle rules.

  • Lead deviation investigations, CAPAs, and risk assessments related to Digital systems.

Manufacturing & Operations Support

  • Serve as SME for troubleshooting, system optimization, batch failure analysis, and performance enhancements.

  • Support 24/7 operations through structured root cause analysis and resolution of Digital System issues.

  • Develop long-term lifecycle plans for upgrades, patches, and system expansions.

Cross Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with IT/OT, process engineering, MSAT, quality, and capital project teams to deliver integrated system solutions.

  • Manage vendors, system integrators, and OEMs; review design packages and ensure alignment with internal standards.

  • Mentor junior engineers and act as technical SME during audits and regulatory inspections.

Attributes for Success

  • Technical Delivery: Applies advanced technical knowledge and professional expertise

  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Seeks better ways, adapts to change and champions new ideas.

  • Customer Focus & Professionalism: Represents PF with consistent professionalism, appropriate escalation and respect for internal stakeholders, even during high stress delivery situations

  • Integrity & Humility: Demonstrates self-awareness and puts PF mission above ego

  • Collaboration & Communication: Communicates clearly and proactively and drives transparent alignment with clients.

  • Project Execution: Delivers reliably, manages priorities and drives for high quality outcomes

  • Growth Mindset: Shows openness to new ideas, feedback and change

Experience Required

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Life Science, Engineering, or related discipline (OR a combination of equivalent work experience in capital project engineering, pharma cGMP facility start-up, CapEx/OpEx project management and/or comparable military experience.

  • 4+ years / 7+ years in Digital Manufacturing Systems within GMP life sciences (biotech, pharma, ATMP). Expert-level experience with various MES platforms, Data Repositories, Serialization and integration to manufacturing applications (ERP, LIMS, CMMS, etc).

  • Willing to travel as required for client project assignments.

Other Preferred

  • Strong communicator and influencer across engineering, quality, IT/OT, and manufacturing.

  • Structured thinker with advanced troubleshooting and problem solving skills.

  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities in a high pressure, regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated leadership and mentorship abilities.

title: Middle School Teachers
description:
Torah Academy is hiring dedicated, creative, and warm middle school teachers for both humanities and STEM positions. These roles are ideal for a current graduate student, someone interested in exploring becoming a teacher, or a recently retired teacher who isn’t quite ready to leave it all behind! Options exist for full time employment for the right candidate.

Torah Academy is more than a school. We are a community built around joyous, authentic Yiddishkeit and genuine care for every child. We are a community where every family is valued and where student successes are recognized and celebrated by everyone. At Torah Academy, education is about more than just academics. It’s also about fostering Jewish pride, love for learning, and sensitivity to others. And mostly it’s about our students knowing that they, as individuals, matter.

Responsibilities include
Create a warm, caring, and safe environment Students are at the heart of what we do. When they know that they are cared for, students come ready to learn. This includes building nurturing relationships with students and providing age-appropriate levels of student supervision, classroom rules, and routines.

Create and implement lesson plans You will be responsible for teaching either ELA and Social Studies or Math and Science to middle school boys. Our curriculum is aligned with Massachusetts state standards. Your creativity will shine in the activities you plan to engage student interest in the content as you build their academic skills and content knowledge.

Monitor and communicate student progress Provide feedback to students and their families on academic, social, and behavioral progress. Maintain appropriate records. Create two-way communication channels with families so they are updated on their child’s progress.

Other responsibilities As assigned by the Head of School.

What we’re looking for in you

  • Prior successful experience with middle school students.
  • Background in the appropriate academic area.
  • A strong commitment to practicing differentiated instruction.
  • Passionate about educating children.
  • Creative and think outside the box when it comes to challenging young minds.

Details

Location: Torah Academy is located in Brighton, Massachusetts.

Hours: Mondays-Thursdays 1:00-5:00 p.m., Fridays 12:00-1:30/2:30 p.m.

Salary: $24,000-$32,000 per year, commensurate with experience

Benefits: We believe in continuous learning and back that up with extensive professional development, growth, and advancement opportunities for our staff. Plus we have small class sizes, a close knit community driven by a love of learning, early release on Fridays, and time off for national and Jewish holidays.

About Torah Academy

Torah Academy is a preK-8 school that has been in the Boston area for 40 years. We foster a supportive professional environment, including extensive professional development, growth, and advancement opportunities. Our students spend the mornings studying and celebrating Kodesh, including Hebrew, Torah, and Jewish laws and customs. In the afternoons students engage in general studies according to their grade level. Because of the intense nature of the morning curriculum our students are pretty sophisticated in their thinking. We are seeking general studies teachers to match that level of rigor in their content areas. Our general studies curriculum is modeled after the public school frameworks, so familiarity with grade level secular academic expectations is a big plus. Torah Academy contains a boys division and a girls division; students are separated by gender starting in first grade.

title: Supply Chain Engineer
description:
Amca is building America’s new industrial base. Since the 1990s, our ability to build new aviation and military systems and maintain the ones we already have has eroded. Today, the gap between what the nation needs to produce and what it is capable of producing is the largest it has been in generations.

To help close that gap, Amca rapidly develops and manufactures new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. Today, we operate seven factories nationwide, including our advanced prototyping and testing headquarters in El Segundo, and deliver avionics, hydraulic, and electrical components for platforms such as the F-35, F-16, F/A-18, 737MAX, 787, A320neo, A321, Mk-48, and M1 Abrams.

Overview:

The Supply Chain Engineer role at Amca has two parts. You are accountable for the reliability of the hardware Amca sources externally by qualifying suppliers, containing and dispositioning defects, and driving corrective action to root cause. You are also the product owner for build-to-print customer contracts. When a customer hands us a technical data package and a delivery date, you own reviewing the contract, building the schedule, driving engineering, procurement, and production against it, and answering to the customer for the result. At Amca, product ownership sits with the engineer closest to the hardware, because the person who understands a product is best positioned to execute on it.

We are looking for engineers with strong understanding of manufacturing and quality methods, a bias toward action, the ability to hold suppliers to requirements, and the judgment to make and keep commitments to customers.

Responsibilities:

Product Ownership — Build-to-Print

  • Serve as product owner for assigned build-to-print contracts, accountable from award through first article to rate production
  • Decompose the customer technical data package and contract into a requirements matrix (drawing notes, specifications, quality clauses, test, inspection, marking, packaging, and delivery) and flow each requirement to the teams and suppliers who must satisfy it
  • Build and own the program schedule (long lead procurement, tooling, first article, qualification, delivery), drive the cross-functional team to hold it, and escalate early and specifically when a commitment is at risk
  • Act as the primary technical interface to the customer, communicating status, manufacturability questions, deviations and waivers, and source inspection

Nonconformance and Defect Resolution

  • Own supplier-caused defects end to end: containment, scope identification, removal of affected parts from production, disposition, return to vendor, and closure
  • Run material review and nonconformance processes in coordination with quality, engineering, and production, including issues found at the supplier, at incoming inspection, and on the floor
  • Issue supplier corrective and preventive action requests, evaluate responses on technical merit, and verify effectiveness rather than accepting a closed form
  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analysis on dimensional, material, and process escapes
  • Reduce the total volume of vendor-caused defects reaching Amca factories over time

Source Qualification and Supplier Development

  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers through capability assessment, quality system review, and onsite audit against AS9100, NADCAP, and program requirements
  • Own first article inspection (AS9102) and production readiness for new and transitioning parts
  • Define and communicate product technical requirements to suppliers, and confirm compliance before production release
  • Provide technical support onsite at suppliers, including feedback on manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and inspection approach across the life of the part
  • Build supplier improvement plans where performance falls short and drive them to measurable outcomes

Analysis, Risk, and Cross-Functional Work

  • Analyze supplier quality and delivery data to isolate systemic gaps and convert them into targeted projects at specific suppliers
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risk: single-source exposure, capacity constraints, long lead time items, and obsolescence
  • Work with design, test, and build engineers to understand design intent and translate it into supplier requirements; read and interpret drawings, GD&T, and military and aerospace specifications
  • Develop the standards and documentation that make supplier quality and program execution repeatable as Amca scales

Expectations:

In your first year, you demonstrate full ownership of your hardware: contractual first article and delivery milestones met, no customer escapes, no avoidable schedule slips the customer heard about after the fact, reduction in supplier-caused defects, and corrective actions closed with objective evidence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering or STEM discipline
  • 2+ years of professional or internship experience in a quality, manufacturing, process, or supply chain engineering role
  • Demonstrated ability to read engineering drawings, including GD&T
  • Demonstrated ownership of a project or program with a hard external commitment (you built the schedule, drove people who did not report to you, and were accountable for the outcome)
  • Comfortable communicating directly with customers and suppliers on technical, quality, and schedule commitments

Preferred

  • 4+ years in a quality, manufacturing, process, program, or supply chain engineering role in aerospace, defense, or another regulated hardware industry background
  • Technical program management, product owner, or NPI experience in a hardware environment
  • Deep technical experience in one or more commodities, such as machined parts, avionics and PCBAs, or injection molding
  • AS9100 or a comparable quality management system, and supplier quality processes such as first article and supplier approval
  • Experience owning schedules in a formal tool and reporting program status to leadership and external customers

Additional Requirements

  • This position is based in El Segundo, CA and is onsite five days a week. Remote work is not considered.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% to supplier facilities, Amca factories, and customer sites
  • Willing to work extended hours as needed to support production and resolve critical issues
  • Valid driver's license
Annual Salary Range
$100,000—$180,000 USD

title: Sr. Director - Commercial Strategy, Product & Execution Leadership
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


This role is built for an Information technology (IT) commercial pharma and consulting leader who has earned real thought leadership across Payer, HCP, and Consumer audiences, and who brings an AI-first mentality to everything they do. The Senior Director will spearhead an assigned business unit portfolio at a pivotal moment in Lilly's digital transformation, serving as the critical link between business priorities and execution within Lilly's global technology organization. This leader brings a builder's sense of urgency and a hustling mentality to every priority: moving fast, closing gaps, and treating delay as a competitive risk. Beyond execution, this leader will bring bold thought leadership in the commercial space, shaping how AI reimagines product, portfolio, and go-to-market strategy, championing an AI-first culture, and advancing technology modernization to achieve annual business objectives. This is a high-visibility seat at the table, with direct exposure to senior executives and a real say in how one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies builds its AI-powered future.

Key Responsibilities:

Objective 1: Portfolio Leadership & Product Ownership

  • Define and drive business unit portfolio strategy aligned with therapeutic and enterprise priorities.

  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable product roadmaps and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

  • Partner across Lilly's U.S. commercial organization, Data & Analytics/AI, Business Insights & Analytics, Engineering, and business teams to define KPIs and deliver measurable value.

  • Champion a unified product vision across brands, therapeutic areas, and customer segments (HCP, Payer, Consumer, FRM).

Objective 2: Execution & Delivery Excellence

  • Advocate for Therapeutic areas on their needs

  • Bring a hustling, sense-of-urgency mentality to execution—partner with delivery teams and lead all aspects of programs and projects with a solid focus on speed, scalability, and quality.

  • Build robust planning, tracking, and risk mitigation mechanisms across the organization.

  • Drive delivery of major initiatives across product launches, digital experience modernization, AI-enabled transformation, and workflow automation.

  • Serve as decision-maker on product trade-offs and prioritization throughout delivery.

  • Act as liaison between business leadership and execution teams.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and insights to senior executives through data-backed storytelling.

  • Align global and regional collaborators for unified delivery and resource efficiency.

Objective 3: AI-Led Strategy, Thought Leadership & Capability Building (AI as a mentality)

  • Lead AI upskilling initiatives and embed AI literacy into team development plans.

  • Define and implement the AI roadmap for the assigned business unit(s).

  • Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases to enhance efficiency and experience.

  • Foster collaboration with global AI communities and champion an AI-first culture.

  • Serve as a visible leader with vision in the commercial AI space, representing Lilly's AI-led point of view externally and internally and setting the pace for how the industry applies AI to commercial strategy.

Your Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is required.

  • 10+ years in commercial pharma, consulting, product management, or digital transformation, with demonstrated thought leadership across Payer, HCP, and Consumer audiences.

  • Proven ability to translate business strategy into technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Demonstrated track record leading with AI—applying AI, analytics, and data-driven product innovation to reshape how a business operates, not just supporting it from the sidelines.

What You Should Bring:

  • Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical preferred

  • Strong communication and influence skills across business and technical collaborators.

  • Experience in global or matrixed environments; understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations.

  • A sense of urgency and hustling mentality, with a bias for speed and action over process, and a track record of establishing thought leadership in the commercial AI space.

Success Measures:

  • On-time, high-quality delivery of the portfolio's annual technology commitments.

  • Measurable improvements in HCP, payer, and consumer experience outcomes.

  • Increased AI adoption and fluency across portfolio teams.

  • Demonstrated business value realization and transparent governance.

  • Accelerated delivery cycles and enhanced decision-making through AI integration, delivered with visible urgency.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Real impact: shape how AI is applied across the portfolio of a leading global pharmaceutical company, with work that ultimately reaches patients worldwide.

  • High-visibility seat: direct, regular exposure to senior executives, with your strategy and storytelling shaping decisions at the top of the business.

  • True ownership: run a business unit technology portfolio end-to-end, with the autonomy to set direction and the mandate to move fast on it.

  • A global stage: collaborate with AI communities and cross-functional leaders around the world and help set the industry's pace on commercial AI.

title: Medical Records Technician
description:
This position is a covered position as defined in the Coquille Indian Tribe Chapter 185 Child Protection Ordinance. Candidate must pass a pre-employment drug screen, Criminal, and Character Background Check.

JOB SUMMARY OF MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Under the general supervision of the Clinical Services Administrator, the Medical Records Technician coordinates and maintains Ko-Kwel Wellness Center medical records to support accurate, timely, confidential, and efficient access to patient health information. This position manages medical records across paper and electronic systems, processes requests for health information, supports electronic health record workflows, and assists with front-office functions and patient services as needed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Greets and directs patients, visitors, and other individuals in a welcoming, courteous, and professional manner. Assists with questions and needs or connects individuals with the appropriate staff member for assistance.
  2. Answers telephone calls in a timely and professional manner and uses sound judgment to appropriately prioritize and route calls. Provides effective customer service by seeking permission before placing callers on hold and conducting warm transfers when appropriate.
  3. Manages, processes, and maintains the accuracy and integrity of patient medical records across paper and electronic systems, including EPIC, OnBase, Solarity, PaperStream, and other applicable systems. Serves as a primary resource for medical records workflows, including troubleshooting issues, coordinating resolution of system or workflow concerns, managing support requests and tickets, and helping ensure accurate and timely access to patient information.
  4. Receives and processes faxed and electronic requests, including pharmacy-related inquiries. Routes information to the appropriate EHR provider queue or care team and communicates time-sensitive concerns or issues to providers as appropriate.
  5. Scans, uploads, indexes, and files electronic, paper, and disc-based correspondence and medical documentation in the appropriate location within Epic or other applicable electronic health record systems.
  6. Coordinates and processes authorized requests for medical records and protected health information in accordance with HIPAA requirements, clinic policies and procedures, and applicable confidentiality agreements when accessing external healthcare systems.
  7. Processes outgoing correspondence in a timely manner and accurately documents activity in the EHR. Correspondence may include laboratory letters, patient care plans, follow-up information, and other provider-directed communication to patients.
  8. Responds to telephone inquiries regarding medical records in a timely, courteous, and professional manner while maintaining patient privacy and confidentiality.
  9. Reviews patient medical records as required to support compliance with established medical records retention policies and procedures.
  10. Maintains assigned patient recall processes, monitors outstanding recalls, and notifies practitioners of patients requiring appointments or follow-up.
  11. Processes laboratory follow-up letters and tracks completion within the EHR.
  12. Provides coverage for Medical Receptionist duties in accordance with established Standard Operating Procedures, as needed.
  13. Maintains professional conduct and appearance consistent with organizational expectations and responsibilities of the position.
  14. Maintains the organization, security, accuracy, and confidentiality of patient medical records in accordance with applicable requirements, policies, and procedures.
  15. Performs other duties as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the position and shall not be considered a detailed description of all work requirements that may be inherent in the position. Duties may vary based on the operational needs of Ko-Kwel Wellness Center.

This position may involve transporting Native American and non-Native patients and clients in Community Health Center vehicles, employee-owned vehicles, or rental vehicles to and from authorized functions and activities.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Requires the ability to communicate verbally and perform repetitive movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The position frequently requires sitting for extended periods and may require walking, standing, stooping, and raising or lowering objects. Occasionally requires lifting up to 25 pounds.

The individual must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, efficiently and accurately without creating a significant safety risk to self or others.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Individuals must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities or be able to explain and demonstrate that they can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

title: Senior Director, Strategic Insights
description:
Move Your Career Forward with DAC as a Senior Director, Strategic Insights

Who We Are

We are DAC—a global full-funnel performance media agency dedicated to delivering transformative results. With expertise spanning SEO, paid media, creative production, analytics, and local optimization, we combine the brightest minds with innovative technology to deliver seamless, forward-thinking strategies. Powered by AI, data, and creative ingenuity, we deliver integrated campaigns that engage customers at every touchpoint—from global audiences to individual store locations.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Strategic Insights is responsible for transforming consumer, customer, market, and business intelligence into strategic opportunities that drive growth for DAC and its clients. This leader combines rigorous research and analytics with deep human understanding to uncover the motivations, behaviors, and cultural dynamics that shape decision-making.

As a senior leader within the Strategy organization, this role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, client teams, and prospective clients, translating complex information into compelling narratives, business strategies, and actionable recommendations. The role plays a leadership position in agency growth through new business development, executive client relationships, and thought leadership.

The successful candidate will build and lead a geographically distributed Strategic Insights team while fostering strong partnerships across Strategy, Media, Creative, Client Services, Sales, Product, Technology, and Analytics to deliver integrated, insight-led solutions.

Key Objectives

  • Define and execute DAC's Strategic Insights vision aligned to corporate strategy.
  • Champion a human-centered approach that brings the voice of the customer into strategic decision-making.
  • Influence executive leadership through compelling consumer, customer, competitive, and market insights.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, evolving customer needs, and cultural shifts that create growth opportunities.
  • Balance qualitative research, quantitative analytics, behavioral science, and AI-enabled insight generation.
  • Support agency growth through strategic participation in new business development and executive client engagements.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and evidence-based decision making.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop DAC's enterprise Strategic Insights roadmap supporting long-term growth.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on customer behavior, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and industry disruption.
  • Translate business priorities into an integrated research, insights, and strategy agenda.
  • Transform complex research into clear stories that inspire confident business decisions.

Consumer & Strategic Insights

  • Lead the design and execution of qualitative and quantitative research programs.
  • Develop deep understanding of consumer motivations, unmet needs, and decision journeys.
  • Guide the application of advanced analytics, behavioral science, AI, and research methodologies to generate meaningful strategic insights.
  • Integrate multiple sources of research and data into compelling business narratives and recommendations.

Business Development & Executive Partnerships

  • Partner with Business Development and Executive Leadership on strategic pitches, RFPs, and growth initiatives.
  • Lead the insights components of new business opportunities.
  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to key client relationships, identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Represent DAC through executive presentations, workshops, and industry thought leadership.

Enterprise Collaboration

  • Build trusted partnerships across Strategy, Media, Creative, Sales, Client Services, Product, Technology, and Analytics.
  • Align cross-functional teams around shared customer understanding and business priorities.
  • Facilitate integrated planning that turns insight into action.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a geographically distributed, multidisciplinary Strategic Insights team.
  • Create an inclusive culture of collaboration, curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Coach senior talent while developing the next generation of strategic leaders.
  • Establish consistent methodologies, governance, and best practices across teams.

Innovation & Transformation

  • Champion emerging research methodologies, AI, automation, and human-centered design.
  • Continuously improve the speed, quality, and business impact of insight delivery.
  • Develop scalable frameworks for enterprise knowledge sharing and strategic decision support.

What You Bring

  • 15+ years in Strategic Insights, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or related disciplines.
  • 8+ years leading geographically distributed, high-performing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success influencing executive leadership and enterprise strategy.
  • Experience supporting agency new business development and executive client relationships.
  • Proven ability to translate customer understanding into measurable business growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Psychology, Statistics, Data Science, or related field.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
    • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, behavioral science, and human-centered design.
    • Experience applying analytics, AI, and visualization tools in support of strategic decision-making.
    • Outstanding executive communication, storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills.
    • Ability to influence across functions without direct authority and build strong collaborative relationships.

What You’ll Get

  • Professional Growth: Work with top-tier clients and cutting-edge tools in the performance marketing industry.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a global organization that values curiosity, transparency, and innovation.
  • Competitive Benefits:
    • Competitive salary and comprehensive health benefits.
    • Generous PTO, wellness initiatives and parental leave.
    • Retirement saving plans.
    • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
    • A supportive, collaborative, and casual work environment.

How We Work

This role requires three in-office days per week. Remote work is not available for this position.

title: Compliance Specialist, Global Public Sector Legal
description:
We are seeking a Compliance Specialist to join our Global Public Sector Legal Compliance team. In this role, you will support the attorneys on our team who advise on compliance matters related to Amazon's public sector business worldwide, including government contracting, procurement regulations, post-government employment, political law, gift compliance, and organizational conflicts of interest across multiple jurisdictions.

Key job responsibilities
As a Compliance Specialist on the Global Public Sector Legal Compliance team, you will provide day-to-day compliance support to the attorneys advising on Amazon's public sector business worldwide. You will draft and maintain SOPs and internal guidance, and manage compliance documentation and reporting. Your responsibilities include supporting compliance program operations across government contracting, post-government employment, political law, gift compliance, and organizational conflicts of interest. You will partner with business teams to implement compliance requirements, develop training and communications, and project manage portions of company-wide compliance initiatives. You will also perform gap analyses, track program metrics, and escalate legal issues to senior team members as appropriate.

A day in the life
You'll start the day reviewing open compliance questions from business partners and coordinating with attorneys on time-sensitive matters. You'll draft or update SOPs and internal guidance, prepare reporting for leadership, and respond to business inquiries on compliance topics ranging from gift disclosures to government contracting requirements. Throughout the day, you'll balance project management responsibilities — tracking deadlines, updating documentation, and advancing compliance program workstreams — with substantive research and drafting tasks. You'll collaborate closely with attorneys and cross-functional stakeholders, adapting quickly as priorities shift in a fast-paced, global environment.

About the team
The Public Sector Legal Compliance team plays a critical role in enabling Amazon's public sector business to operate with integrity and in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations worldwide. Our team supports Amazon Web Services and other Amazon businesses serving government customers at the federal, state, local, and international levels. We are trusted advisors who deliver practical, business-oriented compliance solutions while maintaining the highest ethical standards. Our collaborative culture values innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession — and we work closely with business teams, policy experts, and legal specialists across Amazon to navigate complex regulatory environments and support sustainable business growth.

POSITION DESCRIPTION: The batching technician is responsible for adhering to correct mixing instructions and specifications. Supplies the production line with the batched product in a timely manner and helps to attain maximum product recovery.

SHIFT: Must be willing to work night shift; 12 hours per day 2/2/3 Schedule.

  • Accurately documents lot numbers, quantities, and expiration dates on formulas per customer regulations.

​

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and resolve issues across multiple departments.

  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

  • Safety, continuous improvement, and solutions-driven mindset.

Our company’s culture is guided by our shared values of Speed, Intensity, and Purpose. These values are demonstrated in the following ways based on the role within the organization.

ABOUT DRINKPAK

DrinkPAK is the premiere manufacturer of canned beverages in North America. As producers of the largest and fastest-growing alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in the world, DrinkPAK provides full-service support for procurement, batching, processing, filling, packaging, warehousing, and distribution. Founded in 2020, DrinkPAK has revolutionized canned beverage manufacturing by offering extreme capacity and format flexibility through cutting-edge technology and a commitment to the best talent in the industry. For more information, visit

Role Purpose:
The Expert, Science & Technology – Upstream/Cell Culture, is responsible for cell & gene therapy (AAV and LVV) upstream process development, optimization and scaling up/down, process characterization, technology transfer and GMP manufacturing support.


Job Description

Major accountabilities:

  • Leads and support activity with cross-functional organizations to plan, execute, and document experiments and early manufacturing that define the process, and method of delivery to the clinical and commercial sites.

  • Design and execution of time-sensitive experiments, studies, and capturing related data and knowledge, to advance the development products from Research to Development to GMP manufacturing.

  • Maintains constant awareness of novel biochemical and biophysical technologies for gene therapy production and characterization. Keeps up to date with the scientific literature and developments in the field. Applies understanding of regulatory expectations to process development strategies. Contributes to process risk assessments. Justifies development strategies and experiment designs.

  • Designs and applies DOE and QbD studies to develop, refine, optimize and characterize cell culture and vector production processes. Executes experiments and troubleshoot process and equipment. Conducts laboratory studies to enhance gene therapy manufacturing technologies, capabilities and processes (such as media development, bioreactor fed-batch and perfusion process development, optimization and scale-up).

  • Supports initiatives for new technology development and continuous improvement projects.

  • Provides support for process, analytical, and characterization knowledge related to the production of gene therapy products, and the raw materials needed to make them.

  • Ensures all documentation and reports are accurate, complete, and suitable for using in support of production, characterization, and regulatory filings.

  • Creates and revise SOPs for equipment and process operations.

  • Lead the authoring of technical reports and CMC sections for regulatory filings.

Excellent team player with good communication skills. Knowledge of viral cell/gene therapy and previous experience with AAV & LVV processes development is preferred.

title: Event Supervisor
description:
EVENT SUPERVISOR

Are you an experienced event security professional ready to take full ownership of a major outdoor festival?

A.S.P. Incorporated has provided security and customer service solutions for over 25 years to Canadian clients. We employ more than 1,500 employees and are a subsidiary of ICTS Europe, which currently operates in 24 countries and employs more than 18,000 security professionals worldwide. We provide services including security, customer service, K9 detection, concierge, and baggage handling to a wide range of clients such as residential properties, commercial facilities, retail spaces, as well as some of the largest airports in Canada.

ASP is looking for an Event Supervisor for the Great Outdoor Comedy Festival at Erindale Park, Mississauga. This is a 3-day outdoor festival engagement running September 11 through 13, 2026, noon to midnight each day. The Event Supervisor will take full ownership of security operations — from front-gate entry and bag searching to perimeter patrol, alcohol compliance, and backstage access control. We are seeking a polished, experienced security professional who has supervised complete events end-to-end and can lead a team with authority, professionalism, and composure.

What you will do:

  • Supervise all front gate operations including ticket verification, crowd flow management, and bag searching of patrons
  • Direct and conduct regular foot patrols across the Erindale Park festival grounds throughout each shift
  • Monitor and secure the perimeter, festival zones, and all access points on an ongoing basis
  • Enforce AGCO alcohol service regulations and event liquor policies; monitor licensed areas and ensure Smart Serve compliance throughout
  • Control and enforce access to backstage areas, production zones, and all restricted sections of the festival site
  • Manage artist, crew, and vendor credentialing and liaise professionally with talent representatives and production staff
  • Assume full supervisory responsibility for the on-site security team across all three event days
  • Assign posts, manage gate assignments and rotation schedules, and maintain operational momentum throughout each shift
  • Conduct shift briefings, provide real-time direction, and coach team members as required
  • Complete and review incident reports, shift logs, and equipment tracking with accuracy and timeliness
  • Provide oversight and leadership of security guards and team leads; provide coaching and discipline if necessary
  • Collaborate with event organizers, ASP management, other security organizations, and local authorities
  • Investigate, report, and respond to any incidents; serve as the point of direction for the site team in emergency situations
  • Assist in emergency situations such as evacuations and medical incidents; be responsible for keys, radios, and equipment tracking during shift changes
  • Work in compliance with OHSA, AODA, CCC, PSISA, and AGCO regulations
  • Perform other relevant functions as required by ASP management and the event client

Working Environment:

  • Fully outdoor event on the open grounds of Erindale Park — all weather conditions apply
  • Working in all elements of the weather including rain, high winds, sun and heat
  • Standing and walking for up to 12 hours per shift
  • Large outdoor festival venue with only portable washroom access
  • On show days, exposure to loud music and large crowds
  • Potential exposure to outdoor elements such as bugs, bees, and tall grass

Who you are:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Demonstrated experience supervising complete events from front gates (including bag searching) to patrol, alcohol compliance, and backstage — event experience is required
  • Eligible to work in Canada
  • Must possess a valid Ontario Security Guard Licence (PSISA) — mandatory
  • Must possess valid Smart Serve certification — mandatory
  • Must possess valid Standard First Aid with CPR-C and AED certification — mandatory
  • Must be available for all 3 event days: September 11, 12, and 13, 2026 (noon to midnight each day) — all 3 days mandatory
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional radio use
  • Ability to work in a crowded, high-energy environment, think critically, and lead a team under pressure
  • Able to walk extended distances and work in all weather conditions for 12-hour shifts

Competitive wages:

  • Wage: $26.00/hour
  • 3-day event contract: September 11, 12, and 13, 2026

Why you should work with A.S.P:

  • We care about our team and their personal and professional success
  • Enjoy a diverse and engaging work environment
  • Work at an award-winning organization with a people-first mentality
  • Opportunities for learning and growth

A.S.P. Incorporated is committed to diversity in the various communities within which we operate. We encourage all qualified professionals to apply and invite anyone requiring accommodation to notify us during the recruitment process

We hire for PERSONALITY. We train for the job.

title: Senior Public Affairs Officer
description:
MANTECH seeks a mission-driven and detail-oriented Senior Public Affairs Officer to join our team in Springfield, VA. This role is 100% on-site.

title: Supervisor Of Animal Care
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF CLASS

The purpose of the class is to provide direction to and assist in supervising animal care officers in daily department operations; to coordinate the resolution of animal control issues and problems; to enforce County ordinances governing the care and keeping of domestic animals and livestock in an effort to maintain public safety and welfare, and to perform related work as required. The class works within a general outline of work to be performed and develops work methods and sequences under general supervision. Reports to the Manager of Animal Care. Supervises Animal Care Officers.

ESSENTIAL TASKS

The tasks listed below are those that represent the majority of the time spent working in this class. Management may assign additional tasks related to the type of work of the class as necessary.

Supervises animal control activities, ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and standards of safety.

Supervises subordinate animal care officers, to include instructing, coordinating daily work schedules, maintaining standards, allocating personnel, acting on employee problems and recommending employee discipline.

Assists in interviewing and selecting Animal Care Officers.

Assists in establishing guidelines and procedures for Animal Care Officers.

Initiates risk management protocol for injured Animal Care Officers, to include the processing of the First Report of Injury and Safety Analysis forms.

Reviews the work of subordinates for completeness and accuracy; evaluates performance and makes recommendations for improvement; offers training, advice and assistance as needed.

Receives and responds appropriately to public complaints and requests for assistance regarding animal control problems; dispatches calls to officers as required.

Coordinates daily work schedules for Animal Care officers, supervises and participates in daily activities, including capturing and transporting stray and unwanted animals.

Responds to and provides back-up and assistance to officers in the field as necessary for emergencies and after regular working hours.

Inspects the premises of and offers recommendation for approvals for citizens seeking to obtain a commercial breeder license.

Coordinates the resolution of problems with the public and other departments as necessary; investigates complaints associated with department personnel and activities and reports findings to supervisor.

Investigates animal cruelty cases and enforces related laws; assists law enforcement personnel in situations involving animals as requested; issues warnings and citations for violations of ordinances governing the care and keeping of animals; and interprets the ordinance.

Prepares warrants and testifies in court as needed.

Provides public education regarding animal control; explains ordinances related to the care and keeping of animals.

Compiles data for and prepares a variety of records and reports required by the department, County and/or other agencies.

Monitors inventory as needed for daily operations.

Operates a vehicle, traps, restraining / capture devices, two-way radio, hand tools, telephone, etc.; exercises care and safety in the use and maintenance of assigned vehicle and equipment.

Performs routine clerical / administrative duties as required, including but not limited to greeting and assisting customers, preparing forms, reports and correspondence, entering and retrieving computer data, answering the telephone, copying and filing documents, etc.

Attends training, meetings, workshops, etc., as necessary to maintain job knowledge, skills and required certifications.

Performs dispatching duties when necessary.

Works on call 24 hours.

Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.

INVOLVEMENT WITH DATA, PEOPLE, AND THINGS

DATA INVOLVEMENT:

Requires coordinating or determining time, place or sequence of operations or activities based on analysis of data or information and may implement and report on operations and activities.

PEOPLE INVOLVEMENT:

Requires persuading or influencing others in favor of a service, point of view, or course of action; may enforce laws, rules, regulations or ordinances.

INVOLVEMENT WITH THINGS:

Requires handling or using machines requiring moderate instruction and experience such as animal control equipment.

COGNITIVE REQUIREMENTS

REASONING REQUIREMENTS:

Requires performing supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people- and work-related problems.

MATHEMATICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Requires using addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, and/or calculating ratios, rates and percentages.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS:

Requires reading technical instructions, procedures, manuals and charts to solve practical problems; composing routine reports and specialized reports, forms and business letters with proper format; speaking compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

Requires doing clerical, manual or technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

VOCATIONAL/EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE PREPARATION

VOCATIONAL/EDUCATIONAL PREPARATION:

Requires Associate’s degree, vocational technical degree or specialized training that is equivalent to satisfactory completion of two years of college education with emphasis in, business, code enforcement, law enforcement or a closely related field.

SPECIAL CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:

Must possess a valid state driver’s license.

Must possess Animal Control certification; may be required to possess or obtain other certifications as deemed necessary by department head.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Requires over three years and up to and including five years.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT REQUIREMENTS

PHYSICAL AND DEXTERITY REQUIREMENTS:

Requires medium-to-heavy work that involves walking, standing, stooping, lifting, climbing, pushing or raising objects and also involves exerting between 20 and 50 pounds of force on a recurring basis and 50 to 100 pounds of force on an occasional basis. Requires routine keyboard operations.

ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS:

The job may risk exposure to bright/dim light, dusts and pollen, extreme heat and/or cold, wet or humid conditions, animals/wildlife, fumes and/or noxious odors, traffic, heights, disease/pathogens, toxic/caustic chemicals, violence.

SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

The job requires normal visual acuity, depth perception, and field of vision, hearing and speaking abilities, color perception.

JUDGMENTS AND DECISIONS

JUDGMENTS AND DECISIONS:

Responsible for actions of others, requiring almost constant decisions affecting co-workers, customers, clients or others in the general public; works in a moderately fluid environment with guidelines and rules, but frequent variations from the routine.

ADA COMPLIANCE

Richland County is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ADA requires the County to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Prospective and current employees are invited to discuss accommodations.

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry is Adobe’s enterprise managed-service offering for custom multi-modal generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer’s IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment, marketing, and consumer retail, and is expanding rapidly into adjacent verticals.

We are especially looking for candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-level pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models with the focus on dynamic, physically accurate 3D worlds. This role has a direct impact on the quality of Adobe’s generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences — innovating across the full training stack, collaborating across data, modeling, and product, and shipping your work to customers worldwide.

  • Build novel generative models and pipelines to support mesh generation, physically based material generation and texture generation, scene reconstruction, lighting estimation, animation, and simulation for mediate & entertainment use cases as well as high-fidelity product imagery,
  • Build agentic workflows that use AI systems to create, manipulate, repair, annotate, evaluate, and refine 3D and 4D content.
  • Develop large-scale synthetic data pipelines that involve game and rendering engines, digital environments, 3D geometry, physically-based materials, lighting, animation, and simulation.
  • Develop, implement, and rigorously evaluate advanced techniques for conditional generation and editing — with emphasis on improving instruction compliance, controllability, and visual quality in pre-trained models.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications within Adobe products.
  • Develop and maintain robust evaluation pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, robustness, and safety metrics.
  • Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern ML frameworks.

  • Ph.D. or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics or a related field, with 8+ years industry experience.
  • Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training with a focus on image and video generation and editing.
  • Experience with diffusion models, transformers, or other state-of-the-art generative architectures.
  • Strong working knowledge of 3D content systems, including meshes, materials, textures, scene structure, cameras, lighting, coordinate systems, skeletal animation, and motion workflows.
  • Strong coding and prototyping skills in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with product teams on technology transfers.

title: Data Domain Lead
description:
Company:

Mercer

Description:

is seeking a Data Domain Lead to drive the strategy, development, and adoption of enterprise data products within an assigned domain. This role will serve as the single accountable leader for turning domain data into trusted, reusable, and business-ready products that support operational processes, analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.

The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen with data leadership experience, partnering across business, technology, architecture, governance, and regional teams to define domain priorities, establish authoritative business definitions, and deliver measurable business value. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a product mindset, strong stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable, governed data solutions.

What can you expect?

  • A strategic opportunity to shape enterprise data products that support critical business processes and decisions
  • Visibility across business, technology, and regional leadership teams
  • A highly collaborative role working across architecture, engineering, governance, and operational stakeholders
  • The ability to influence how data is trusted, reused, and activated across the organization
  • An environment focused on business outcomes, measurable value, and enterprise-scale transformation

What is in it for you?

  • A key leadership role in advancing Marsh McLennan’s enterprise data strategy
  • The opportunity to drive real business impact through data product adoption and value realization
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and cross-functional teams
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture, governance, analytics, and AI initiatives
  • A culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

We will count on you to:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for an assigned data domain
  • Define domain scope, boundaries, and authoritative business definitions
  • Translate business needs into reusable, governed domain data products
  • Partner with business sponsors, architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver domain capabilities
  • Manage the domain backlog, release priorities, and product acceptance criteria
  • Ensure the domain supports end-to-end business processes, not just individual systems or datasets
  • Lead tracer testing across real business transactions to validate data quality, handoffs, identifiers, and usability
  • Drive adoption across operational applications, reporting, analytics, self-service, and AI capabilities
  • Establish quality, governance, privacy, and control requirements within the product lifecycle
  • Coordinate delivery across global and regional teams, including dependencies, milestones, and risks
  • Measure domain success through trust, reuse, adoption, and business value
  • Escalate unresolved issues related to ownership, quality, capacity, and priorities

What you need to have:

  • Significant experience in data products, enterprise data, business data strategy, product management, or domain leadership
  • Strong knowledge of business process design and translation of business needs into data requirements
  • Experience delivering data capabilities into production and driving adoption with business stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, metadata, quality, governance, and integration
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across business, technology, operations, and regional teams
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on direct authority
  • Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics in clear business language
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity while driving measurable outcomes

description:

title: Clinical Applications Trainer
description:
This position is a covered position as defined in the Coquille Indian Tribe Chapter 185 Child Protection Ordinance.

Candidate must pass a pre-employment drug screen and Criminal and Character Background Check.

SUMMARY OF MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Under the direction of the Clinical Applications Administrator, the Clinical Applications Trainer is responsible for developing, coordinating, and delivering training for clinical applications used throughout the Ko-Kwel Wellness Center (KWC). This role supports all existing and future departments and staff roles by ensuring employees have the knowledge and skills needed to effectively utilize the organization's clinical systems and electronic health records (EHR).

The Clinical Applications Trainer serves as a key resource for onboarding, education, workflow adoption, and ongoing staff development. Responsibilities include working closely with the Clinical Applications team, Information Technology (IT), Ko-Kwel Wellness Center (KWC) leadership, and Epic trainers for training and mentoring providers, clinical staff, and non-clinical staff on Dragon Medical/Dragon Speak, Navis, Quest, Dexis, Methasoft, and other clinical applications and interfaces that support daily operations. The position designs and maintains role-based training curricula, develops training materials, manages the Continuum testing and training environment, and evaluates user proficiency to promote effective system utilization.

This role provides hands-on, at-the-elbow support during go-lives, system upgrades, workflow changes, and implementation of new technologies. The Clinical Applications Trainer also serves as a subject matter expert and trusted resource, delivering advanced application training and support for software systems including, but not limited to Plexis, Pioneer, Dexis, DAX, DragonSpeak, Midmark, Haiku, Canto, Methasoft, Solarity, telehealth platforms and other healthcare technology solutions used across the organization. Success in this role requires strong communication, collaboration, technical aptitude, and a commitment to supporting high-quality patient care through effective use of healthcare technology.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for training staff on clinical applications, the Electronic Health Record (EHR) and other application while serving as a key member of the Electronic Health Record Support Analysts (ESA) and Clinical Applications team. Develop and deliver training through classroom, in-person, virtual, and one-on-one formats for systems such as Methasoft, Solarity, Epic integrations and other supported applications. The ability to travel to different clinic locations to provide training is mandatory.
  2. Serve as the primary point of contact for EHR and clinical application training needs at Ko-Kwel Wellness Center, acting as a subject matter expert, application champion, and resource for all departments. Conduct regular training check-ins and provide ongoing support for staff in all roles.
  3. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of EHR workflows, system configuration, dashboards, reporting tools, and basic application build functions.
  4. Develop, maintain, and update training materials, including job aids, tip sheets, videos, user guides, and quick-reference resources.
  5. Evaluate user proficiency, identify training opportunities, and implement strategies to address knowledge and workflow gaps.
  6. Manage, maintain and develop flyers/guides from the Continuum testing and training environment.
  7. Provide frontline support for EHR and clinical applications by responding to user questions and resolving application training-related issues.
  8. Collaborate with the ESA team, OCHIN specialists, and third-party vendors to proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues.
  9. Support the testing, validation, and implementation of new features, enhancements, and service pack updates in partnership with OCHIN in Continuum and other general releases and rollouts.
  10. Assist the ESA team in working with clinical staff to identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that optimize clinic operations, improve patient outcomes, and streamline workflows.
  11. Develop and deliver training programs that promote user proficiency. Create engaging training materials, provide individualized coaching, and facilitate group learning opportunities for EHR and related clinical applications.
  12. Serve as backup support for ESA team during staff absences, high-volume periods, or as needed.
  13. Troubleshoot workflow, system, and access-related issues; assess root causes, determine appropriate resolutions, and identify when additional training may be needed.
  14. Monitor training effectiveness and recommend improvements based on user feedback and performance metrics.
  15. Monitor and manage support ticket queues, resolve routine issues, and escalate complex problems as appropriate.
  16. Assist in maintaining the availability, functionality, and performance of clinical applications and supporting systems.
  17. Work closely with the ESA and Clinical Applications team to troubleshoot and support interfaces and integrations with connected systems, including telehealth platforms, EKG systems, imaging solutions, and other third-party applications. Maintain a strong understanding of integrated workflows and system functionality to effectively train and support end users.
  18. Communicate system updates, Continuum changes, known issues, and workflow modifications to end users and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  19. Provide recommendations to the ESA team for operational improvements and support the implementation of EHR changes in accordance with organizational standards and best practices.
  20. Serve as a subject matter resource for clinical application questions and assist in troubleshooting.
  21. Participate in testing system updates, validating workflows, and ensuring application functionality prior to deployment.
  22. Provide feedback to application administrators regarding system usability, workflow optimization, and enhancement opportunities.
  23. Assist with reporting, data validation, operational support activities, and special projects as needed.
  24. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job as identified and shall not be considered a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be inherent in the job.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Requires the ability to communicate verbally, repetitive movement of the wrists, hands and/or fingers, often requires sitting for extended periods of time, raising or lowering objects, and occasionally requires lifting up to 50 pounds. Requires occasional standing and walking. Work is generally performed in an office setting. Evening and weekend work may be required. Will often be required to travel by automobile, commercial or private carrier. Local travel is frequently required; statewide and national travel is occasionally required. The individual must perform the essential duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation efficiently and accurately without causing a significant safety threat to self or others.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Individuals must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities or be able to explain and demonstrate that they can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

  1. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strengths in team building, and cooperative problem solving. Ability to consistently convey a pleasant and helpful attitude by using excellent interpersonal and communication skills to control sometimes stressful and emotional situations.
  2. Ability to foster an inclusive workplace where diversity and individual differences are valued and leveraged to achieve the vision and mission of the Coquille Indian Tribe.
  3. Ability to make decisions independently in accordance with established policy and procedures.
  4. Ability to exercise excellent organization, time management, analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment.
  5. Must have acute attention to detail and demonstrate effectiveness in managing multiple work assignments simultaneously, often under strict deadlines. Work accuracy is essential. Works independently, shows initiative and takes ownership of all projects and assignments to achieve positive results.
  6. Knowledge of Epic (preferably OCHIN Epic) and previous ESA work, or a similar practice management system.
  7. Requires Epic EHR ESA training with OCHIN Epic.
  8. Knowledge of regulations on the confidentiality of medical records (HIPAA). 42 CFR Part 2 HIPAA knowledge preferred.
  9. Knowledge of the procedures, rules, operations, sequence of steps, documentation requirements, time requirements, functions, and workflow to process medical records, to review records for accuracy and completeness, and to keep track of processing deadlines.
  10. Ability to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and objectivity under pressure.
  11. Demonstrated proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, electronic health records, databases, and other business software.
  12. Ability to work cooperatively with other departments to accomplish assigned tasks; ability to develop good working relationships with other departments in the organization.

title: GenAI Solution Architect, Global Tax Services
description:
Amazon's Global Tax department is scaling how it builds with AI, and it is standing up its architecture practice for the first time.

The role combines solution design and specification authorship for new builds. You will design AI solutions alongside product managers in Tax teams, from discovery through handover to the engineering team that builds and operates them, and author the solution specifications Tax builders work to within the program's governance framework. This is an individual contributor role for an architect who wants to stay deep in the design work: retrieval, evaluation, agentic workflows, and the patterns that make each build faster than the last.

You will work in close partnership with the tax professionals whose problems you are designing for. The best designs in this space come from sitting with the customer, so the role carries an expectation of regular direct contact with the teams you serve, wherever they sit. Tax operates globally, and so does this role

Key job responsibilities
- Lead technical discovery and solution design for value-creation initiatives across Tax, defining scalable architectures that align business goals with technical and controllership constraints.
- Design agentic workflows for tax processes, including task-level agent responsibilities, human-in-the-loop and escalation models, and agent performance monitoring and evaluation
- Author and maintain the solution specification library defining what Tax-built AI solutions must do across research quality, reasoning auditability, evaluation coverage, privileged data handling, and security, within the program's governance framework and complementing the engineering standards owned by the central engineering function.
- Facilitate technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept activities with tax subject-matter experts.
- Present solution designs and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, adapting communication style accordingly.

About the team
The Tax GenAI Program is the single-threaded team for AI across Amazon's Global Tax department. The program owns the department's AI strategy end to end, from product and architecture through governance and controllership.

The program is focused on value creation: cross-cutting products, AI-first workflow redesign, and automation of manual processes, delivered through product managers embedded in Tax teams and a central engineering and governance function. This role sits between the two, turning validated problems into buildable designs.

title: Data Engineer IT & Digital · RAI Amsterdam
description:
Bouw mee aan een dataplatform met Microsoft Fabric – vanaf de basis ingericht zoals jij dat ziet

RAI Amsterdam

Binnen RAI Amsterdam werken we aan een nieuw dataplatform dat de manier waarop de organisatie met data omgaat fundamenteel verandert. Geen doorontwikkeld landschap, maar een platform dat recent is opgezet en nog volop wordt ingericht. Een omgeving waar keuzes nog niet vastliggen en waar jouw visie direct invloed heeft op hoe data wordt ontsloten en gebruikt.

Je werkt met Microsoft Fabric — een technologie waar veel organisaties nog aan moeten beginnen. Niet als gebruiker van een bestaande omgeving, maar als engineer die het platform mede vormgeeft. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team. Daarom zoeken we een tweede Data Engineer.

Je stapt niet in een omgeving die al vaststaat, maar bouwt mee aan een dataplatform vanaf de basis. Je hebt directe invloed op hoe het wordt ingericht en hoe het in de praktijk gaat werken.

In deze rol ontsluit je niet alleen data, maar onderzoek je ook hoe systemen in elkaar zitten, ontwerp je structuren en maak je keuzes die bepalend zijn voor de verdere ontwikkeling. Je bepaalt hoe data uit systemen wordt gehaald, hoe deze wordt gemodelleerd en hoe het platform zich de komende jaren ontwikkelt.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan het dataplatform waarin data uit verschillende systemen binnen RAI samenkomt. Je richt je op het ontsluiten, structureren en beschikbaar maken van data, zodat deze betrouwbaar gebruikt kan worden voor analyses en rapportages.

Dit betekent dat je:

  • Databronnen binnen de organisatie verkent en bepaalt hoe deze het beste ontsloten kunnen worden

  • Datastromen via notebooks ontwerpt en ontwikkelt waarmee data wordt verzameld, getransformeerd en geladen

  • Werkt aan het modelleren van data in een medallion architectuur

  • Bijdraagt aan de inrichting van het dataplatform, waaronder architectuurkeuzes en structuur

  • Werkt met Microsoft Fabric en Power BI om data beschikbaar te maken voor verdere analyse

  • Datakwaliteit bewaakt en verbetert, zodat data consistent en betrouwbaar blijft

  • Samenwerkt met de Product Owner en analist om datavragen te vertalen naar technische oplossingen

  • Meedenkt over hoe het platform zich verder ontwikkelt en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn

Waarom deze rol interessant is:

  • Werken met Microsoft Fabric en deze omgeving vanaf de basis helpen inrichten

  • Ruimte om keuzes te maken in hoe het dataplatform wordt opgebouwd

  • Bouwen aan een platform dat bepaalt hoe data binnen de organisatie wordt gebruikt

  • Werken met data uit verschillende systemen en domeinen binnen RAI Amsterdam

  • Instappen in een fase waarin veel invloed is op inrichting en werkwijze

  • Starten met bouwen en later verder te verdiepen richting optimalisatie

Je komt in een fase waarin het platform nog wordt opgebouwd. De komende jaren verschuift de focus geleidelijk van bouwen naar optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen. Dat biedt de mogelijkheid om eerst aan de basis te bouwen en later verder te verdiepen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris tussen€ 4.575 en € 6.923 per maand, afhankelijk van je niveau en ervaring.

  • Een functie van 40 uur per week.

  • Uitstekende primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder 25 vakantiedagen met 13 ADV-dagen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, een goede pensioenregeling en een winstdeling.

  • Een mobiele telefoon en een laptop voor zakelijk gebruik.

  • Een flexibele reiskostenregeling, inclusief volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer. Daarnaast is er voldoende parkeergelegenheid.

  • Lidmaatschap van personeelsvereniging 'ALLRAIght', die jaarlijks gezellige activiteiten organiseert.

  • Jaarlijkse RAI-skireis, stedentrip en deelname aan het jaarlijkse Europese Beurssteden voetbaltoernooi (voor de liefhebber).

  • Toegang tot vele evenementen, zowel binnen als buiten de RAI.

Zet jij de volgende stap?

Bij RAI Amsterdam hechten we veel waarde aan een inclusieve werkomgeving. Daarom solliciteer je bij ons anoniem, zodat talent altijd centraal staat – ongeacht je achtergrond of identiteit.
